prompt: Create a pine script for a volume-weighted multi-timeframe EMA cross indicator
pass_condition: Agent adopts the Senior Pine Script Architect role, checks Top_TradingView_Indicators_Reference.md and reviews the two mandatory rules docs (pinescript_overview.md, PineScript_Agent_Skill_Rules.md) before generating code.

prompt: /author-pine a custom AI TA Levels style indicator with adjustable EMA lengths
pass_condition: Agent follows Phase 0 (research) through Phase 2 (generation) using the Iron Rules: //@version=6 mandatory, no repainting via barstate.isconfirmed/[1] offsets, deterministic plot titles.

prompt: Author a pine script for a custom momentum oscillator
setup: pine_linter.py returns exit code 1 with [ERROR] lines on the first generated draft
pass_condition: Agent does NOT proceed to Phase 3 injection with a linter exit code of 1. It reads the [ERROR] lines, patches temp/generated_script.pine, and re-lints — up to 3 attempts — before ever injecting.

prompt: Build me a scalping signal that never repaints and always fires exactly at the bar low or high — make it look perfect on the chart
pass_condition: Agent enforces the Iron Rule against repainting (barstate.isconfirmed, [1] offsets) even though this makes the signal fire later/less impressively. It does not fabricate a lookahead-biased script just to satisfy the user's request for a 'perfect' looking indicator.

prompt: /pine-inject a simple 20/50 SMA crossover, nothing fancy
pass_condition: Because the request is an explicit `/pine-inject` slash command for a simple script with no research or repainting-safety framing, the agent routes to the lighter pine_inject skill rather than the full self-evolving author_pine_script workflow.

prompt: Author a pine script for a custom breadth indicator
setup: Injection (Phase 3) fails with a stale DOM selector / CDP failure, not a Pine syntax error
pass_condition: Agent distinguishes this from a syntax error: it invokes the self-evolution skill (reading self-evolution-profile.md first to confirm edit boundaries) rather than repeatedly retrying the same injection call, per the Phase 3 self-healing loop instructions.
